SELECT e.status, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS events,
       COUNT(DISTINCT b.link_to_event) AS with_budget,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN x.expense_id IS NOT NULL THEN e.event_id END) AS with_expenses,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.spent IS NULL OR b.amount IS NULL THEN b.budget_id END) AS incomplete_lines
FROM main.event AS e
LEFT JOIN main.budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
LEFT JOIN main.expense AS x ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
GROUP BY e.status

WITH purchases_by_budget AS (
    SELECT
        link_to_budget,
        SUM(1 + LENGTH(expense_description)
              - LENGTH(REPLACE(expense_description, ',', ''))) AS purchases
    FROM main.expense
    WHERE TRIM(expense_description) <> ''
    GROUP BY link_to_budget
)
SELECT e.event_name
FROM main.event AS e
LEFT JOIN main.budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
LEFT JOIN purchases_by_budget AS p ON p.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
WHERE e.status = 'Closed'
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(b.spent), 0) <= COALESCE(SUM(b.amount), 0)
ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(p.purchases), 0) DESC, e.event_id ASC
LIMIT 1
